## Installing

**Mac:** open `Pigeonhole-…-mac.dmg` and drag Pigeonhole into Applications.
The first time you open it, macOS says it can't check the app for malware
(it isn't signed with a paid Apple developer account). Click **Done**, then
go to System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down and click **Open
Anyway** next to Pigeonhole. You only need to do this once.

**Windows:** run `Pigeonhole-…-windows-setup.exe`. If Windows says it
protected your PC, click **More info** → **Run anyway** (the installer isn't
signed). It installs just for you, with no admin prompt. Prefer not to
install? Unzip `…-windows-portable.zip` and run `Pigeonhole.exe`.

**Updating:** install the new version over the old one. Your accounts and
chats are kept.
